# Vendored Sparkle framework

This folder contains the Sparkle 2.10.0 universal macOS XCFramework and its license. The framework was extracted from Sparkle’s official release archive:

`https://github.com/sparkle-project/Sparkle/releases/download/2.10.0/Sparkle-for-Swift-Package-Manager.zip`

The SHA-256 of that upstream archive is `17e28312b8e18ab7cdbbe09a6fb28cc55a5479ec6c371dbc07cdecd2a14fd959`.

The updater signing key is not part of this repository. `sign_update` is included only as a local release tool and reads the private Ed25519 key from the `ed25519` item in the maintainer’s login Keychain.
